frictions.description: The storeHours field has a default value set in the HTML (value='Mon-Sat: 10AM-8PM | Sun: 10AM-7PM') matching its placeholder, which causes it to be pre-filled on page load. This required manually clearing the value for VAL-SAVE-002 (empty form test). The field also does not appear in agent-browser snapshot when its value equals its placeholder.
frictions.resolution: Used document.getElementById('storeHours').value = '' to clear the default before testing empty form submission, and used 'find placeholder' locator to fill the field when needed.

frictions.description: Toast notifications auto-remove after 3 seconds with a 0.3s slide-out animation, making it difficult to capture toast text after form submission. Standard eval after click misses the toast.
frictions.resolution: Used MutationObserver on the toast container to capture toast messages as they are added to the DOM, then checked the captured array immediately after the click.

frictions.description: Form submission redirects after 1 second, making it impossible to verify toast AND localStorage on the same page load without preventing the redirect.
frictions.resolution: Patched window.setTimeout to intercept and prevent navigation callbacks that contain 'location.href', allowing post-submit verification without page navigation.

summary: Tested 7 assertions: 7 passed. All save, redirect, and navigation fade-out behaviors work correctly. Frictions encountered: storeHours HTML default value, toast auto-removal timing, and redirect timing requiring test infrastructure workarounds.
